tagline.en_US: Run a single-node S3-compatible object storage service with an embedded web console. It uses one image and a persistent data directory; no external database or Redis service is required.

description.en_US: RustFS is a distributed object storage system offering S3 API and OpenStack Swift compatibility. It includes an embedded web console for managing buckets, files, and identity policies directly in a browser. The platform supports features such as object versioning, bitrot protection, server-side encryption, and lifecycle management.
